75. Chapter
Distribution of recovered sums among creditors

### 621. Section. Issuance of Recovered Amounts to Creditors

(1)	From the amount that the bailiff has recovered from the debtor, enforcement costs are covered first, and from the remaining amount the claims of creditors that are substantiated by enforcement documents in the possession of this bailiff are satisfied. The amount that remains after satisfaction of all claims is returned to the debtor.  

(2)	Amounts that have been recovered from the debtor and are to be transferred to creditors are deposited into the bailiff's deposit account, and thereafter issued or transferred in the prescribed manner.  

(3)	Amounts that are to be credited to state revenues are paid by the bailiff into the State Treasury budget account.  

(4)	Amounts that have been recovered in favour of a person residing abroad are transferred to the creditor in the prescribed manner.  

(5)	Persons who have enforcement documents in other cases may join the enforcement by submitting the enforcement document to the bailiff who is organising the auction no later than seven days before the auction closing date indicated in the auction notice or until the date when the property has been handed over to a trading company for sale under commission terms.  
(With amendments made by the laws of 31.10.2002., 05.02.2009. and 28.05.2015., which enter into force on 02.07.2015.)

### 622. Section. Order of Satisfaction of Creditors' Claims

(1)	If the amount recovered from the debtor is insufficient to satisfy all claims under enforcement documents, this amount shall be divided among the creditors in the order specified in this law, unless a separate law establishes priorities for certain creditors.  

(2)	Claims of each subsequent priority are satisfied after complete satisfaction of claims of the previous priority.  

(3)	If the recovered amount is insufficient to fully satisfy all claims of one priority, these claims shall be satisfied proportionally to the amount due to each creditor.  

(4)	If there are several enforcement cases in the bailiff's proceedings that have been initiated for the claims referred to in the first paragraph of Section 623 of this law, and among them is an enforcement case in which the Maintenance Guarantee Fund Administration has been substituted for the creditor in part for the recovery from the debtor of maintenance payments that have been paid from the Maintenance Guarantee Fund, and the recovered amount is insufficient to fully satisfy all claims, the recovered amount shall be divided proportionally to the calculated debt amount in the enforcement cases or the total amount of debts if there are several creditors in the case.  
(With amendments made by the law of 08.12.2016., which enters into force on 04.01.2017.)

### 623. Section. First Priority Enforcement

(1)	The following shall be satisfied first:

1)	claims for recovery of maintenance for a child or parent or claims of the Maintenance Guarantee Fund Administration for recovery of maintenance debt;  

2)	claims for recovery of wages;  

3)	claims for personal injuries resulting in mutilation or other health damage or death of a person;  

4)	claims for compensation for harm satisfied in favour of a natural person in a criminal case.  

(2)	If maintenance is paid in accordance with a decision of the Maintenance Guarantee Fund Administration and the recovered maintenance amount:

1)	does not cover the amount of maintenance paid from the Maintenance Guarantee Fund, the recovered maintenance is credited to the Maintenance Guarantee Fund;  

2)	covers the amount of maintenance paid from the Maintenance Guarantee Fund, but does not cover the minimum amount of maintenance as determined by the Cabinet of Ministers on the basis of the fifth paragraph of Section 179 of the Civil Law, the recovered maintenance is paid to the applicant;  

3)	covers the minimum amount of maintenance as determined by the Cabinet of Ministers on the basis of the fifth paragraph of Section 179 of the Civil Law, then the maintenance in the amount specified by the Cabinet of Ministers is paid to the applicant, and the remaining amount is credited to the Maintenance Guarantee Fund until complete repayment of the debt.  

(3)	If the bailiff's proceedings include an enforcement case for recovery of maintenance for a child and a case in which the Maintenance Guarantee Fund Administration has been substituted for the same creditor in part for the recovery from the debtor of maintenance that has been paid from the Maintenance Guarantee Fund, but the payment of maintenance to the creditor from the Maintenance Guarantee Fund has been terminated because the debtor's obligation to provide monthly maintenance to his or her child has ended, the recovered maintenance is credited to the Maintenance Guarantee Fund until complete repayment of the debt.  
(With amendments made by the laws of 17.06.2004., 09.06.2011., 08.12.2016., 22.06.2017., 21.01.2021. and 25.03.2021.  
which enters into force on 20.04.2021.)

### 624. Section. Second Priority Enforcement

In the second priority, claims for taxes and non-tax payments to the budget shall be satisfied.

### 625. Section. Third Priority Enforcement

In the third priority, the following shall be satisfied:

1)	claims of natural persons for compensation for damage caused to their property by a criminal offence, if compensation for damage has been determined on the basis of a court judgment in a civil case or administrative violation;  

2)	claims for payments for management activities in a multi-apartment residential building (management expenses), for payments for services necessary for the maintenance of the building (utility services) and payments to the apartment owners' association reserve fund (reserves), which are payable for this immovable property.  
(In the wording of the law of 21.01.2021., which enters into force on 01.03.2021. See transitional provision 162)

### 626. Section. Fourth Priority Enforcement

In the fourth priority, all other claims shall be satisfied.

### 627. Section

Distribution of Money Received from the Sale of Movable Property Encumbered by a Pledge

From the money received for the sale of movable property encumbered by a pledge, enforcement costs are covered first, then claims are satisfied in the following order:

1)	the claim secured by the pledge;  

2)	other claims in the order specified in this law.

### 628. Section

Distribution of money received from the sale of mortgaged immovable property

(1) From the money received for the sale of mortgaged immovable property, first the costs of enforcement of the judgment related to the sale of the immovable property shall be covered, then claims shall be satisfied in the following order:

1) claims of those employees for payment of wages who are related to the maintenance of the immovable property, and social insurance payments related to their wages;

2) claims for tax payments payable for this immovable property;

21) claims for payments for management activities in a multi-apartment residential building (management expenses), for payments for services necessary for the maintenance of the building (utility services) and payments to the accumulation fund of the apartment owners' association (accumulations) payable for this immovable property;

3) real burdens registered in the Land Register for which the payment term has arrived;

4) claims secured by the mortgage of this immovable property according to their priority;

5) other claims in the order specified in this law, including the claims specified in point 2.1 of this paragraph in their unsatisfied part.

(11) When satisfying claims in the order specified in point 2.1 of the first paragraph of this section, they shall be covered in an amount that in total does not exceed 5 percent of the money received for this immovable property.

(2) When satisfying mortgage claims according to their priority, their ancillary claims shall also be satisfied simultaneously — interest for the last three years until the day of conclusion of the auction, awarded court costs and costs related to the conduct of the case, not exceeding the mortgage sum registered in the Land Register. In the remaining part not secured by the mortgage (hypothec) of the immovable property, the claim shall be satisfied in the order specified in Section 622 of this law.

(21) If the mortgage creditor has not joined the enforcement (fifth paragraph of Section 621), the money in the amount of the mortgage sum indicated in the Land Register or in the amount indicated in the mortgage creditor's notice, if such has been received (fourth paragraph of Section 600), taking into account the priority of the respective mortgage claim, shall be deposited in the deposit account of the bailiff who conducted the auction and kept until receipt of the enforcement documents.

(3) If immovable property has been sold at auction in respect of which a note of pledge right is registered in the Land Register, the money in the amount of the claim according to the priority of the claim shall be deposited in the bailiff's deposit account and kept until the secured claim is examined in court.
(With amendments made by the laws of 31.10.2002., 05.02.2009., 28.05.2015. and 21.01.2021., which enter into force on 01.03.2021. See transitional provision point 161)

### 629. Section. Distribution of money received from the sale of a ship

From the money received for the sale of a ship, the costs of enforcement of the judgment shall be covered and other claims satisfied, taking into account the second paragraph of Section 56 of the Maritime Code.
(In the wording of the law of 19.06.2003., which enters into force on 24.07.2003.)

### 630. Section

Order of enforcement in cases where the debtor's property has been confiscated by a judgment in a criminal case

(1) When executing a judgment in a criminal case on confiscation of property, the bailiff shall pay the funds obtained by executing the judgment on confiscation of property into the State Treasury budget account after all claims submitted to the debtor that arose before the convicted person's property was seized or pledged by the preliminary investigation authorities or the court have been satisfied.

(2) Claims for maintenance and claims for personal injury resulting in mutilation or other health damage or death of a person shall be satisfied even if they arose after the seizure or pledging of the convicted person's property.
(With amendments made by the laws of 31.10.2002. and 22.06.2017., which enters into force on 01.08.2017.)

### 631. Section. Calculation prepared by the bailiff

(1) If the court has recognized the claimant's right to receive interest on the awarded sum until the execution of the judgment (the day of conclusion of the auction) or if the obligation to pay interest is specified in another law, the bailiff shall prepare a calculation of the total sum to be paid to the claimant.

(2) If there are several claimants and if the sum recovered from the debtor is insufficient to fully satisfy all claims, the bailiff shall prepare a calculation for the distribution of money among the claimants and issue it to the claimants and the debtor.

(3) If the auction of immovable property has been declared not to have taken place and the creditor, co-owner or last outbid bidder has expressed a wish to retain the immovable property for themselves, the bailiff shall prepare a calculation to determine the sum due from this person.

(4) The calculation prepared by the bailiff may be appealed to the district (city) court according to the bailiff's place of office. An appeal may be submitted against the court's decision.
(With amendments made by the laws of 19.06.2003., 17.06.2004., 05.02.2009., 28.05.2015. and 11.11.2021., which
enters into force on 01.12.2021.)

Chapter 76
Protection of the rights of the claimant, debtor and other persons when executing a court judgment

### 632. Section. Appeal of the bailiff's actions

(1) The bailiff's actions in the execution of a judgment or their refusal to perform such actions, except for the case specified in Section 617 of this law, may be appealed by the claimant or debtor by submitting a reasoned complaint to the district (city) court according to the bailiff's place of office within 10 days from the day of performance of the appealed action or the day when the complainant, who has not been notified of the time and place of the action to be performed, became aware of it.

(2) The complaint shall be examined in a court session within 15 days. The debtor and the claimant, as well as the bailiff, shall be notified of the court session. The non-appearance of these persons is not an obstacle to the examination of the matter.

(3) At the reasoned request of the complainant, the judge may adopt a decision in the procedure specified in Section 140 of this law to postpone the enforcement action, to prohibit the bailiff from transferring money or property to the claimant or debtor, or to suspend the sale of property. The decision shall be executed immediately after its adoption.

(4) An appeal may be submitted against the court's decision.
(With amendments made by the laws of 31.10.2002., 19.06.2003. and 05.02.2009., which enters into force on 01.03.2009.)

### 633. Section. Protection of the rights of other persons when executing a decision

(1) A person who believes that they have any rights to the described movable property or immovable property against which enforcement is directed, or a part thereof, shall bring an action in court according to general jurisdiction.

(2) An action for exclusion of property from the description act, deletion of the enforcement note in the Land Register or another action shall be brought against the debtor and the claimant. If property has been described on the basis of a judgment in a criminal case in the part on confiscation of property, the convicted person and the financial institution shall be summoned as defendants.

(3) If the property has already been sold, the action shall also be submitted against the persons to whom the property has been transferred. If the court satisfies the action in respect of immovable property, the entry in the Land Register on the transfer of ownership rights to its acquirer shall be declared invalid.

(4) Disputes between the acquirer, claimant and debtor, if an action for the return of sold property in kind has been satisfied, shall be examined by the court in action proceedings.
(With amendments made by the law of 31.10.2002., which enters into force on 01.01.2003.)

### 634. Section. Reversal of execution of judgment

(1) If an executed judgment is revoked and after a new examination of the case a judgment is made to reject the claim or a decision is adopted to terminate the proceedings in the case or to leave the case without examination, the defendant shall return everything that was recovered from them in favour of the plaintiff according to the revoked judgment (reversal of execution of judgment).

(2) If it is not possible to return the property in kind, the judgment or decision of the court shall provide for compensation of the value of this property.

### 635. Section. Decision on reversal of judgment enforcement

(1) The court to which the case has been referred for a new hearing shall, on its own initiative, examine the question of reversal of judgment enforcement and decide it in the new judgment or decision by which the proceedings in the case are concluded.

(2) If the court hearing the case anew has not decided the question of reversal of enforcement of the annulled judgment, the defendant is entitled to submit to that court an application for reversal of judgment enforcement. This application shall be examined at a court hearing, having notified the parties to the case in advance. The non-appearance of these persons shall not be an obstacle to the examination of the application.

(3) The court of cassation, if it amends the appealed (protested) judgment by its judgment, annuls it and terminates the proceedings in the case or leaves the application without examination, shall decide the question of reversal of judgment enforcement or refer its decision to the court whose judgment was appealed.

(4) If the court of appeal rejects the claim in a case in which the court of first instance, in accordance with Section 205 of this law, has allowed immediate enforcement of the judgment, or terminates the proceedings in such a case or leaves the claim without examination, it shall simultaneously decide the question of reversal of judgment enforcement.

(5) If the judgment is annulled due to newly discovered circumstances or due to review of the decision in cases provided for in European Union legal norms, the question of reversal of judgment enforcement shall be decided by the court which, after annulment of the judgment, hears the case anew.

(6) In cases concerning recovery of maintenance, recovery of wages, recovery of damages in connection with personal injuries resulting in mutilation or other health damage or death of a person, reversal of judgment enforcement is permissible if the annulled judgment was based on false information provided by the claimant or on forged documents submitted by him or her.

(7) An appeal may be lodged against the court's decision on the question of reversal of judgment enforcement.
(With amendments made by the law of 08.09.2011, which enters into force on 30.09.2011. Part six, insofar as it relates to reversal of judgment enforcement in cases concerning recovery of wages, has been declared invalid from 01.11.2015 by the judgment of the Constitutional Court of 16.04.2015, which enters into force on 20.04.2015.)

Part F International Civil Procedure
(Part in the wording of the law of 07.04.2004, which enters into force on 01.05.2004.)

Section Fifteen International Civil Procedural Cooperation

Chapter 77
Recognition and enforcement of foreign court decisions

### 636. Section. Foreign court decision

(1) A foreign court decision within the meaning of this chapter is a judgment adopted by a foreign court by which a dispute between the parties has been decided on the merits, as well as a settlement approved by a foreign court.

(2) A foreign court decision within the meaning of this chapter is also a decision of a foreign competent authority that is enforceable in the country of its adoption, if the recognition and enforcement of the decision follows from directly applicable European Union legal norms or international agreements binding on the Republic of Latvia.
(In the wording of the law of 07.09.2006, which enters into force on 11.10.2006.)

### 637. Section. Recognition of a foreign court decision

(1) A foreign court decision shall be recognised in accordance with the provisions of this chapter, observing the general provisions of this law.

(2) A foreign court decision shall not be recognised only if one of the following grounds for non-recognition exists:

1) the foreign court which adopted the decision was not competent, in accordance with Latvian law, to hear the respective dispute or such a dispute is subject to exclusive jurisdiction of a Latvian court;

2) the foreign court decision has not entered into legal force;

3) the defendant has been denied the opportunity to defend his or her rights, in particular if the defendant who has not participated in the hearing of the case has not been notified in a timely and proper manner of the appearance in court, except if the defendant has not appealed this decision, although he or she has had such an opportunity;

4) the foreign court decision is incompatible with a court decision already adopted in Latvia and having entered into legal force in the same dispute between the same parties or with proceedings already initiated in a Latvian court between the same parties;

5) the foreign court decision is incompatible with a decision of another foreign court already adopted and having entered into legal force in the same dispute between the same parties, which is recognisable or has already been recognised in Latvia;

6) recognition of the foreign court decision is contrary to the public order of Latvia;

7) when adopting the foreign court decision, the law of the country that should have been applied in accordance with the conflict of laws norms of Latvian private international law has not been applied.

(3) A foreign court decision in cases arising from guardianship, trusteeship or contact rights shall not be recognised only if at least one of the grounds for non-recognition referred to in points 1, 2, 3, 6 and 7 of part two of this section exists or one of the following grounds for non-recognition exists:

1) the foreign court decision is incompatible with a court decision later adopted in Latvia and having entered into legal force in the same dispute between the same parties or with proceedings later initiated in a Latvian court between the same parties;

2) the foreign court decision is incompatible with a decision of another foreign court later adopted and having entered into legal force in the same dispute between the same parties, which is recognisable or has already been recognised in Latvia.

(31) A foreign court decision in cases concerning recovery of maintenance, which amends a decision on recovery of maintenance already adopted earlier, on the basis that circumstances have changed, shall not be considered an incompatible judgment within the meaning of points 4 and 5 of part two of this section.

(4) When deciding the question of whether a foreign court decision is recognisable in accordance with part two of this section, the judge or court shall be guided by the circumstances established by the foreign court decision.

(5) If several claims combined in one claim have been satisfied by a foreign court decision and this decision is not recognisable in full, the foreign court decision may be recognised in respect of one or more satisfied claims.
(With amendments made by the laws of 07.09.2006 and 29.10.2015, which enters into force on 03.12.2015.)

### 638. Section. Submission of Application

(1)	An application for recognition or recognition and enforcement of a foreign court judgment shall be submitted for examination to the district (city) court according to the place of enforcement of the judgment or according to the respondent's declared place of residence, but if there is none — according to the respondent's place of residence or registered address.

(2)	The application shall indicate:

1)	the name of the court to which the application is submitted;

11)	the applicant's name, surname, personal identity number (if there is none — other identification data) and address for communication with the court; for a legal person — its name, registration number and registered address. If the applicant agrees to electronic communication with the court, an email address shall also be indicated and, if registered in the online system for communication with the court, a reference to the registration shall also be included;

12)	the respondent's name, surname, personal identity number (if there is none, then other identification data), declared place of residence and additional address indicated in the declaration, but if there is none — place of residence; for a legal person — its name, registration number and registered address;

2)	(deleted by law of 29.11.2012.);

3)	the subject matter of the application and the circumstances on which the application is based;

4)	the applicant's request to recognize or recognize and enforce the foreign court judgment in full or in part;

5)	the representative's email address and, if registered in the online system for communication with the court, also a reference to the registration, if the application is submitted by a representative whose address for communication with the court is in Latvia and he or she agrees to electronic communication with the court. If the applicant's representative's address is outside Latvia, an email address shall additionally be indicated or notification of registration of participation in the online system shall be given;

6)	a list of attached documents;

7)	the time of preparation of the application.

(21) An application in a case concerning recognition or declaration of enforceability of a foreign court judgment on maintenance in cases provided for in European Union and international treaties, using the forms specified in the relevant legal acts, may be submitted or transmitted through the intermediary of the Latvian central authorities appointed to ensure cooperation.

(3)	The following shall be attached to the application:

1)	the foreign court judgment with confirmation that the judgment has entered into legal force;

2)	a document issued by the foreign court certifying that the respondent who did not participate in the examination of the case was notified in due time and in proper manner of the time and place of examination of the case;

3)	a document issued by the foreign court or competent institution concerning the enforcement of the judgment, if the foreign court judgment has already been partially enforced;

4)	a document issued by the foreign court certifying that the foreign court judgment is enforceable in the country of its adoption, if the applicant requests recognition and enforcement of the foreign court judgment;

5)	a translation into the official language of the application and the documents referred to in points 1, 2 and 3 of this paragraph certified in the prescribed manner;

6)	a document confirming payment of the state fee in the manner and amount prescribed by law, except where the application has been submitted and payment made in the online system".

(4)	The application shall be signed by the applicant or his or her representative. If the application is signed by a representative, a power of attorney or other document certifying the representative's authority to apply to the court with the application shall be attached to the application.

(5)	An unsigned application shall be considered as not submitted and shall be sent back to the submitter.

(6)	The judge shall adopt a decision to refuse to accept the application if a power of attorney or other document certifying the representative's authority to apply to the court with this application is not attached. The decision is not subject to appeal.
(With amendments made by laws of 02.09.2004., 07.09.2006., 09.06.2011., 08.09.2011., 29.11.2012., 23.04.2015.,
29.10.2015., 23.11.2016., 01.06.2017. and 11.11.2021., which enters into force on 01.12.2021.)

### 639. Section. Leaving Application Without Movement

If the application does not comply with the requirements of the second and third paragraphs of Section 638 of this Law or if the power of attorney or other document attached to the application does not show the authority of the representative to apply to the court with this application, the judge shall leave the application without movement and the consequences provided for in Section 133 of this Law shall occur.
(In the wording of law of 23.04.2015., which enters into force on 26.05.2015.)

### 640. Section. Determination of Application

A decision on recognition and enforcement of a foreign court judgment or a decision to reject the application shall be adopted by the judge individually on the basis of the submitted application and the documents attached thereto within 10 days after initiation of the case, without summoning the parties.
(With amendments made by law of 23.04.2015., which enters into force on 26.05.2015.)

### 641. Section

Appeal of Entry into Force of Decision of First Instance Court and Appellate Court

(1)	An appeal may be submitted to the regional court against a decision of the first instance court in a case of recognition of a foreign court judgment, and a decision of the regional court on an appeal may be appealed to the Supreme Court by submitting an appeal.

(2)	A party to the case whose declared place of residence, but if there is none — place of residence or registered address is in Latvia may submit the appeal referred to in the first paragraph of this Section within 30 days from the date of issue of the decision, but a party to the case

whose declared place of residence, but if there is none — place of residence or registered address is not in Latvia — within 60 days from the date of issue of the decision.

(21) In cases provided for in Council Regulation No 4/2009, a party to the case whose declared place of residence, but if there is none — place of residence or registered address is not in Latvia may submit the appeal referred to in the first paragraph of this Section within 45 days from the date of issue of the decision.

(3)	The decision of the first instance court and the decision of the appellate court shall enter into legal force after the time limit for appeal thereof has expired, counting from the later date of issue of the decision, and no appeal has been submitted.

(4)	If in the case referred to in the third paragraph of this Section the relevant confirmation of issue of the decision has not been received, the decision shall enter into legal force six months after its pronouncement.
(With amendments made by laws of 05.02.2009., 09.06.2011., 29.11.2012., 30.10.2014. and 11.11.2021., which
enters into force on 01.12.2021.)

### 642. Section. Competence of Regional Court

(1)	The regional court, when examining an appeal, shall have the right to:

1)	leave the decision unchanged and reject the appeal;

2)	annul the decision in full or in part and decide the question of recognition of the foreign court judgment;

3)	amend the decision.

(2)	The court may request explanations from the parties or additional information from the foreign court that adopted the judgment.

(21) When applying Council Regulation No 4/2009, the appeal shall be examined within the time limits set out in Article 34 of Council Regulation No 4/2009.

(3)	The court, at the request of the respondent, may suspend proceedings if the foreign court judgment has been appealed in the relevant foreign country in the general procedure or the time limit for such appeal has not expired. In the second case, the court may set a time limit within which an appeal must be submitted for appeal of the foreign court judgment in the relevant foreign country.
(With amendments made by laws of 09.06.2011., 30.10.2014. and 23.04.2015., which enters into force on 26.05.2015.)

### 643. Section. Securing Enforcement of Foreign Court Judgment

(1)	Upon application of the applicant, the judge or court in the decision by which the foreign court judgment is recognized may determine the measures provided for in Section 138 or Chapter 77.3 of this Law for securing enforcement of the foreign court judgment.

(2)	Submission of the appeal referred to in the first paragraph of Section 641 of this Law shall not suspend execution of the decision of the judge or court in the part concerning securing enforcement of the foreign court judgment. Submission of an appeal against such a decision in a case of recognition of a foreign court judgment by which the securing of enforcement of the foreign court judgment has been cancelled or the security measure has been changed shall suspend execution of the decision in this part.
(With amendments made by laws of 07.09.2006. and 08.12.2016., which enters into force on 04.01.2017. Amendments to the Section in connection with the European Account Preservation Order enter into force on 18.01.2017. See transitional provision point 121)

### 644. pants. Ārvalsts tiesas nolēmuma izpilde

(1)	A foreign court judgment that is enforceable in the country of its adoption shall be enforced, after its recognition, in the procedure specified in this Law.

(2)	With regard to the procedure for declaring a judgment enforceable as provided for in the Lugano Convention of 30 October 2007 on jurisdiction and the recognition and enforcement of judgments in civil and commercial matters, Council Regulation No 2201/2003, Council Regulation No 4/2009 and Regulation (EU) No 650/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 4 July 2012 on jurisdiction, applicable law, recognition and enforcement of decisions and acceptance and enforcement of authentic instruments in matters of succession and on the creation of a European Certificate of Succession (hereinafter – Regulation No 650/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council), the provisions of Chapter 77 of this Law on the recognition of foreign court judgments shall apply insofar as the provisions of the relevant conventions and regulations permit.

(3)	In the cases provided for in Council Regulation No 2201/2003, Regulation (EC) No 805/2004 of the European Parliament and of the Council, Regulation (EC) No 861/2007 of the European Parliament and of the Council, Regulation (EC) No 1896/2006 of the European Parliament and of the Council, Council Regulation No 4/2009, Regulation (EU) No 1215/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council, Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council and Council Regulation (EU) 2019/1111, foreign court judgments shall be enforceable in the procedure specified in this Law without requiring recognition of the foreign court judgment or a declaration of enforceability of the foreign court judgment.

(4)	Costs related to the enforcement of a foreign court judgment shall be covered in the general procedure.
(07.09.2006. likuma redakcijā ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 05.02.2009., 09.06.2011., 29.11.2012., 30.10.2014., 28.05.2015., 08.12.2016. un 16.06.2022. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 07.07.2022. Grozījums trešajā daļā stājas spēkā 01.08.2022. Sk. pārejas noteikumu 177. punktu)

644.1 pants. Deferral of enforcement of a foreign court judgment, division of enforcement into instalments, change of the method or procedure of enforcement

(1)	The court that has adopted a decision on the recognition and enforcement of a foreign court judgment may, upon application by a party to the case, defer the enforcement of the foreign court judgment, divide the enforcement into instalments, or change the method or procedure of enforcement.

(11) The district (city) court in whose territory of operation a foreign court judgment is to be enforced, in respect of which a certificate referred to in point (b) or (c) of Article 36(1) or point (a) or (b) of Article 47(1) of Council Regulation (EU) 2019/1111 has been issued, may, upon receipt of an application by the debtor, on the basis of Article 56(4) of that Regulation, defer the enforcement of the foreign court judgment.

(2)	The application shall be examined in written proceedings, after prior notification to the parties to the case. Simultaneously with the notification, the court, setting a time limit for the submission of explanations, shall send to the parties to the case the application for deferral of enforcement of the judgment, division into instalments, or change of the method or procedure of its enforcement.

(21)	An application in a case concerning a child shall be examined at a court hearing, after prior notification to the parties and the orphan's court. The failure of the parties to appear shall not be an obstacle to the examination of the application.

(22)	In a decision on deferral of enforcement of a foreign judgment in a case concerning a child, the court shall specify the obligations of the debtor and the creditor during the period when enforcement of the judgment is deferred and, if necessary, also the procedure for restoring the relationship between the child and the creditor.

(3)	A decision on deferral of enforcement of a foreign court judgment, division into instalments, or change of the method and procedure of enforcement shall be enforceable immediately. An appeal may be lodged against the court decision. The lodging of an appeal shall not suspend the enforcement of the decision.
(07.09.2006. likuma redakcijā ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 08.09.2011., 29.10.2015. un 16.06.2022. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 07.07.2022. 1.1, 2.1 un 2.2 daļa; grozījums pirmajā daļā un trešās daļas jaunā redakcija stājas spēkā 01.08.2022. Sk. pārejas noteikumu 177. punktu)

644.2 pants. Enforcement matters related to European Union enforcement instruments

(1)	The district (city) court in whose territory of operation the relevant foreign court judgment is to be enforced may, upon application by the debtor, on the basis of Article 23 of Regulation (EC) No 805/2004 of the European Parliament and of the Council, Article 23 of Regulation (EC) No 861/2007 of the European Parliament and of the Council, Article 23 of Regulation (EC) No 1896/2006 of the European Parliament and of the Council, Article 21(3) of Council Regulation No 4/2009, Article 44 of Regulation (EU) No 1215/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council or Article 56(1) and (2) of Council Regulation (EU) 2019/1111, be entitled to:

1)	replace the enforcement of the judgment with the measures provided for in Section 138 of this Law to secure the enforcement of that judgment;

2)	change the method or procedure of enforcement of the judgment;

3)	suspend the enforcement of the judgment.

(2)	(Deleted by the Law of 23.04.2015.)

(3)	The application referred to in paragraph one of this Section shall be examined at a court hearing, after prior notification to the parties to the case. The failure of these persons to appear shall not be an obstacle to the examination of the application.

(4)	An appeal may be lodged against the court decision.
(07.09.2006. likuma redakcijā ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 05.02.2009., 09.06.2011., 30.10.2014., 23.04.2015. un 16.06.2022. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 07.07.2022. Grozījums pirmajā daļā stājas spēkā 01.08.2022. Sk. pārejas noteikumu 177 punktu)

644.3 pants. Refusal of enforcement of a foreign court judgment

(1)	The district (city) court in whose territory of operation a foreign court judgment certified as a European Enforcement Order is to be enforced may, upon receipt of an application by the debtor, on the basis of Article 21 of Regulation (EC) No 805/2004 of the European Parliament and of the Council, refuse enforcement of the judgment.

(2)	The district (city) court in whose territory of operation a foreign court judgment is to be enforced, in respect of which a certificate referred to in Article 41(1) or Article 42(1) of Council Regulation No 2201/2003 has been issued, may, upon receipt of an application by a party to the case, on the basis of Article 47 of that Regulation, refuse enforcement of the judgment.

(3)	The district (city) court in whose territory of operation a foreign court judgment is to be enforced, in respect of which a certificate referred to in Article 20(2) of Regulation (EC) No 861/2007 of the European Parliament and of the Council has been issued, may, upon receipt of an application by a party to the case, on the basis of Article 22 of that Regulation, refuse enforcement of the judgment.

(4)	The district (city) court in whose territory of operation a European order for payment is to be enforced may, upon receipt of an application by the debtor, on the basis of Article 22 of Regulation (EC) No 1896/2006 of the European Parliament and of the Council, refuse enforcement of the judgment.

(41)	The district (city) court in whose territory of operation a foreign court judgment is to be enforced, in respect of which an extract referred to in point (b) of Article 20(1) of Council Regulation No 4/2009 has been issued, may, upon receipt of an application by the debtor, on the basis of Article 21(2) of that Regulation, refuse enforcement of the judgment.

(42)	The district (city) court in whose territory of operation a foreign court judgment is to be enforced, in respect of which a certificate referred to in Article 53 or 60 of Regulation (EU) No 1215/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council has been issued, may, upon receipt of an application by the debtor, on the basis of Article 46 of that Regulation, refuse enforcement of the judgment.

(43)	The district (city) court in whose territory of operation the enforcement control of a protective measure established by a foreign court judgment is to be carried out may, upon receipt of an application by a person, on the basis of Article 13 of Council Regulation No 606/2013, refuse enforcement of the judgment.

(44)	The district (city) court in whose territory of operation a foreign court judgment is to be enforced, in respect of which a certificate referred to in point (b) or (c) of Article 36(1) or point (a) or (b) of Article 47(1) of Council Regulation (EU) 2019/1111 has been issued, or an authentic instrument issued by a foreign authority or a certified agreement in respect of which a certificate referred to in point (b) of Article 66(1) of Council Regulation (EU) 2019/1111 has been issued, may, upon receipt of an application by the debtor, on the basis of Articles 41, 50, Article 56(6) or Article 68(3) of that Regulation, refuse enforcement of the judgment, authentic instrument or agreement, respectively.

(5)	The application shall be examined at a court hearing, after prior notification to the parties to the case. The failure of these persons to appear shall not be an obstacle to the examination of the application.

(6)	An appeal may be lodged against the court decision.

644.4 pants. Submission of an application for deferral of enforcement of a foreign court judgment, a European Union enforcement instrument, division into instalments, change of the method or procedure of enforcement, suspension or refusal of enforcement

(1)	The application referred to in Sections 644.1, 644.2 and 644.3 of this Law shall specify:

If the applicant agrees to electronic communication with the court, the e-mail address shall also be indicated and, if registered in the online system for communication with the court, also include an indication of registration;

12)	the respondent's (creditor's) name, surname, personal identity number (if there is none, then other identification data), declared place of residence and additional address indicated in the declaration, but if there are none – place of residence; for a legal person – its name, registration number and legal address;

If the applicant's representative's address is outside Latvia, the e-mail address shall additionally be indicated or notification of registration of his or her participation in the online system shall be given;

6)	a list of attached documents;

7)	the time of preparation of the application.

(2)	The application shall be accompanied by:
