4) a report on the debtor's monetary funds in bank accounts and cash, the value of the debtor's fixed assets and current assets;
5) an opinion on whether insolvency proceedings set in Point 1 or 2 of Article 3 of Regulation (EU) 2015/848 of the European Parliament and of the Council are to be commenced against the debtor. (In the wording of the Law of 22 May 2008 with amendments made by the Law of 31 May 2018, which enters into force on 1 July 2018.)

33. In insolvency proceedings in which an insolvency application has been submitted to the court until 31 December 2007, but a judgment on declaration of insolvency is adopted after this date, the court shall determine the representatives of the debtor in the judgment based on the list of the debtor's representatives submitted by the administrator, and shall determine their duties in accordance with the regulatory enactments that regulated the insolvency of enterprises and commercial companies until 31 December 2007. (In the wording of the Law of 22 May 2008, which enters into force on 25 June 2008.)

34. The court shall not terminate those insolvency proceedings in which an insolvency application has been submitted to the court until 31 December 2007 when approving a settlement. The court shall adopt a decision on termination of insolvency proceedings in cases of conclusion of a settlement if it establishes that the debtor has settled all its obligations for which the performance time limit has arrived and after settlement of these obligations its assets exceed the remaining debt amount. (In the wording of the Law of 22 May 2008, which enters into force on 25 June 2008.)

35. In insolvency proceedings in which an insolvency application has been submitted to the court until 31 December 2007, the court shall decide on cancellation of a settlement on the basis of a respective application if:

1) when concluding the settlement, requirements of regulatory enactments have been violated;
2) the conclusion of the settlement was achieved by using fraud or coercion, or occurred under the influence of error;
3) the debtor does not fulfil the obligations provided for in the settlement. (In the wording of the Law of 22 May 2008, which enters into force on 25 June 2008.)

36. In insolvency proceedings in which an insolvency application has been submitted to the court until 31 December 2007 and in which issues are to be decided in court in accordance with the regulatory enactments that regulated the insolvency of enterprises and commercial companies until 31 December 2007, complaints may be submitted:

1) by the administrator — against any decision of the creditors' meeting and decision of the creditors' committee, as well as against a decision of the Insolvency Control Service regarding the administrator's actions;
2) by an interested creditor or group of creditors — against a decision of the creditors' meeting by which a claim of a creditor has been recognised or rejected, within three weeks from the day of the creditors' meeting or the day the creditor who did not participate in the creditors' meeting was notified of its decision;
3) by a creditor or group of creditors — against a decision of the creditors' meeting (creditors' committee) on administration expenses and the procedure for settling debts within three weeks after its adoption. (In the wording of the Law of 22 May 2008 with amendments made by the Law of 31 May 2018, which enters into force on 1 July 2018.)

37. In insolvency proceedings in which an insolvency application has been submitted to the court until 31 December 2007 and in which further issues are to be decided in court in accordance with the regulatory enactments that regulated the insolvency of enterprises and commercial companies until 31 December 2007, the debtor may submit to the court an application for termination of insolvency proceedings if it has settled all debt obligations within the specified time limits and the value of assets exceeds the remaining debt obligation amount. (In the wording of the Law of 22 May 2008, which enters into force on 25 June 2008.)

38. Orders which have been issued for making deductions until 28 February 2009 in accordance with Article 597 of this Law shall be enforceable in accordance with what is indicated in the respective bailiff's order. (In the wording of the Law of 5 February 2009, which enters into force on 1 March 2009.)

39. Until the day the Cabinet of Ministers regulations referred to in the second paragraph of Article 39 of this Law enter into force, but no longer than until 1 September 2009, Cabinet of Ministers Regulation No. 154 of 27 April 1999 "Procedure by Which Amounts Payable to Witnesses and Experts and Expenses Related to the Search for the Defendant Are Calculated in Civil Cases" shall apply insofar as they are not in conflict with this Law. (In the wording of the Law of 5 February 2009, which enters into force on 1 March 2009.)

40. A court that has commenced hearing a civil case until 28 February 2009, the materials of which include a state secret object, shall complete the commenced hearing of the civil case. (In the wording of the Law of 5 February 2009, which enters into force on 1 March 2009.)

41. Amendments regarding the third paragraph of Article 345 of this Law (on extension of the time limit for approval of the plan of legal protection process measures to 30 days) shall enter into force simultaneously with amendments to the Insolvency Law which provide that the plan of legal protection process measures is simultaneously sent to the administrator and secured creditors for providing an opinion, as well as to unsecured creditors — for approval. (In the wording of the Law of 5 February 2009, which enters into force on 1 March 2009.)

42. Paragraph seven of Article 363.9 of this Law shall not apply to settlements approved in court until 30 June 2009. (In the wording of the Law of 11 June 2009, which enters into force on 1 July 2009.)

43. If an auction of immovable property has been announced until 31 January 2010, it shall be held according to the announced terms. If the announced second auction has not taken place and no one wishes to retain the immovable property for themselves (Article 615), at the creditor's request, after one month from the day of publication of the announcement, the bailiff shall hold a third auction, observing the terms of the first auction, but bidding shall start from an amount corresponding to 60 per cent of the starting price in the first auction. (In the wording of the Law of 17 December 2009, which enters into force on 1 February 2010.)

44. In the period from 1 February 2010 to 31 December 2012, in addition to what is set in the third paragraph of Article 600 of this Law, a mortgage creditor in whose favour a first mortgage has been consolidated, unless it is also the creditor, shall simultaneously be requested to inform the bailiff whether it agrees to the sale of the immovable property, except in cases where enforcement is carried out in favour of such claims:

1) for enforcement of maintenance for a child or parent;
2) for enforcement of wages;
3) for personal injury resulting in mutilation or other health damage or death of a person;
4) for tax and non-tax payments to the budget;
5) for compensation for losses caused to the property of natural persons by a criminal offence or administrative violation;
6) for debt enforcement in favour of an insolvency subject. (In the wording of the Law of 17 December 2009 with amendments made by the Law of 9 June 2011, which enters into force on 18 June 2011.)

45. If a mortgage creditor in whose favour a first mortgage has been consolidated objects to the sale of immovable property (Point 44 of the transitional provisions), the bailiff shall postpone levy of enforcement on the immovable property for one year, but no longer than until 31 December 2012. (In the wording of the Law of 17 December 2009, which enters into force on 1 February 2010.)

46. To legal protection proceedings, out-of-court legal protection proceedings, legal person insolvency proceedings, as well as natural person insolvency proceedings commenced until 31 October 2010, Chapters 46, 46.1 and 46.2 of this Law in the wording that was in force until 31 October 2010 and Point 42 of the transitional provisions shall apply. (In the wording of the Law of 30 September 2010, which enters into force on 1 November 2010.)

47. Cases on dissolution of marriage upon a joint application of both spouses and cases on deposit of the subject of an obligation with the court for safekeeping, which have been accepted for hearing in courts until 31 January 2011, shall be heard in the procedure set out in the Civil Procedure Law as it was in force until 31 January 2011. (In the wording of the Law of 28 October 2010, which enters into force on 1 February 2011.)

48. An auction of movable property announced until 31 January 2011 shall be held in accordance with the provisions that were in force on the day of announcement of the auction. (In the wording of the Law of 28 October 2010, which enters into force on 1 February 2011.)

49. The new wording of Point 7 of the first paragraph of Article 34 of this Law (which provides for the state fee amount for an application for undisputed compulsory enforcement, for compulsory enforcement of obligations in warning procedure or for voluntary sale of immovable property at auction through the court — 2 per cent of the debt amount or the value of the property to be returned or sold at voluntary auction, but not more than 350 lats) shall enter into force on 1 February 2011. (In the wording of the Law of 20 December 2010, which enters into force on 1 January 2011.)

50. The new wording of the sixth paragraph of Article 587 of this Law (which provides that a person who has bid for the item being sold shall pay the full amount bid and value added tax if the auction price is subject to value added tax, no later than the next working day after the auction) shall enter into force on 1 February 2011. (In the wording of the Law of 20 December 2010, which enters into force on 1 January 2011.)

51. In relation to auctions of movable property and immovable property announced until 31 December 2010, those norms of the Civil Procedure Law that were in force until 31 December 2010 shall apply. (In the wording of the Law of 20 December 2010, which enters into force on 1 January 2011.)

52. Point 3 of the first paragraph of Article 133 of this Law, Chapter 30.3, as well as amendments to the first paragraph of Article 37, the second and fourth paragraphs of Article 406.4, the second and third paragraphs of Article 406.6, the second and third paragraphs of Article 406.8, the first and third paragraphs of Article 450 and the fifth paragraph of Article 486 of this Law shall enter into force on 1 October 2011. (In the wording of the Law of 8 September 2011, which enters into force on 30 September 2011.)

53. The provisions of Chapter 30.3 of this Law shall not apply to the hearing of claim applications received by the court until 30 September 2011. (In the wording of the Law of 8 September 2011, which enters into force on 30 September 2011.)

54. State fees paid until 30 September 2011 in cases on compulsory enforcement of obligations in warning procedure shall be refunded in the procedure set out in the Civil Procedure Law as it was in force until 30 September 2011. (In the wording of the Law of 8 September 2011, which enters into force on 30 September 2011.)

55. The amendment to the fifth paragraph of Article 486 of this Law regarding the distinguishability of arbitral tribunal names shall not apply to an arbitral tribunal name entered in the register of arbitral tribunals until 30 September 2011. (In the wording of the Law of 8 September 2011, which enters into force on 30 September 2011.)

56. The second sentence of Article 24 of this Law [on the competence of the Land Register division of a district (city) court in hearing applications for undisputed compulsory enforcement and compulsory enforcement of obligations in warning procedure] and the third paragraph of Article 566, as well as the amendment providing for deletion of the introductory part of the second paragraph of Article 34, and amendments to Article 403 and the second paragraph of Article 406.2 [on submission of applications to the Land Register division of a district (city) court] shall enter into force on 1 January 2012. (In the wording of the Law of 4 August 2011, which enters into force on 1 October 2011.)

57. An administrator whom the court has removed from performance of his or her duties by decision in the period from 1 November 2010 to 1 July 2012 on the basis of Point 7 of the second paragraph of Article 22 of the Insolvency Law may appeal this court decision in the procedure set out in the seventh paragraph of Article 341.8, the twelfth paragraph of Article 363.14 or the ninth paragraph of Article 363.28 of this Law until 11 July 2012. A decision of a regional court is not grounds for reinstatement of the administrator in the insolvency proceedings or legal protection proceedings from which he or she was removed. (In the wording of the Law of 21 June 2012, which enters into force on 1 July 2012.)

58. (Deleted by the Law of 19 December 2013, which enters into force on 4 January 2014.)

59. If the court has established temporary guardianship based on Point 1 of Article 21 of the Law "On the Time and Procedure for Entry into Force of the Family Law Part of the Restored Civil Law of the Republic of Latvia of 1937" and within one month after the day these amendments enter into force an application for restriction of a person's legal capacity and establishment of guardianship has not been submitted, the judge shall adopt a decision on termination of temporary guardianship. The decision on termination of temporary guardianship shall be sent to the orphan's court for enforcement, to the prosecutor, the guardian and the person whose legal capacity has been restricted. (In the wording of the Law of 29 November 2012, which enters into force on 1 January 2013.)

60. If the court has suspended proceedings based on Points 2 and 3 of Article 21 of the Law "On the Time and Procedure for Entry into Force of the Family Law Part of the Restored Civil Law of the Republic of Latvia of 1937", it shall resume proceedings on its own initiative, upon an application by a party to the case or the guardian. If a person who is the applicant in the suspended case has lost the right to bring an action in cases on establishment of guardianship or review of restriction of legal capacity in accordance with amendments to the Civil Law and Civil Procedure Law which entered into force on 1 January 2013, the court shall notify the prosecutor's office thereof and the prosecutor shall take the place of the applicant. When resuming proceedings, the court shall explain to the applicant his or her rights to amend the subject and grounds of the application. Such cases shall be heard in court in the procedure set out in the Civil Procedure Law as it is in force from the day these amendments enter into force. (In the wording of the Law of 29 November 2012 with amendments made by the Law of 23 May 2013, which enters into force on 1 November 2013.)

61. A person whom the court has recognised as legally incapable until 31 December 2011 due to mental illness or insanity and has established guardianship due to its wasteful or extravagant life, as well as due to use of alcohol or other intoxicating substances, shall henceforth be considered a person with restriction of legal capacity without restriction of personal non-property rights. Until the respective amendments to other regulatory enactments enter into force, the legal regulation regarding a legally incapable person and a person for whom guardianship has been established due to its wasteful or extravagant life, as well as due to use of alcohol or other intoxicating substances, shall be interpreted and applied in accordance with what is set in this Law and the Civil Law. (In the wording of the Law of 29 November 2012, which enters into force on 1 January 2013.)

62. The legal incapacity of the person referred to in Point 61 of these transitional provisions shall be reviewed according to the same provisions as for a person with restriction of legal capacity. The guardian has a duty to submit to the court an application for review of restriction of legal capacity regarding the person referred to in Point 61 of these transitional provisions within four years after these amendments enter into force, if an application for review of restriction of legal capacity has not been submitted to the court or a judgment regarding it has not entered into force. If after the said time limit an application for review of a person's restriction of legal capacity has not been submitted to the court or a judgment regarding it has not entered into force, the orphan's court shall inform the prosecutor's office within one year from expiry of the time limit for the duty imposed on the guardian of such legally incapable persons for whom it is necessary to review the restriction of legal capacity.The court informs the Population Register that it has received an application for the review of the restriction of legal capacity of a person lacking legal capacity, which was submitted after four years from the date on which the respective amendments entered into force. The Population Register informs the prosecutor's office which person, after four years from the date on which these amendments entered into force, does not have a judgment in force regarding the review of the restriction of legal capacity and for whom the person referred to in paragraph 61 of these transitional provisions has had proceedings for the review of the restriction of legal capacity initiated in court. The prosecutor's office submits an application to the court for the review of the restriction of legal capacity of the said person within seven years from the date of entry into force of these amendments. (In the wording of the law of 29.11.2012, which enters into force on 01.01.2013.)

63. Until the date of entry into force of the amendments to Article 483 of this law, a complaint submitted to the relevant official shall be examined in accordance with the provisions that were in force on the date of submission of the complaint. (In the wording of the law of 29.11.2012, which enters into force on 01.01.2013.)

64. The amendments made to paragraph 4.2 of the first part of Article 11, paragraph 3.1 of Article 251 and Chapter 34.1 "Suspension of the Rights of a Future Attorney" of this law in connection with future authorisation shall enter into force simultaneously with Section III1 "Future Authorisation" of the first subsection of Chapter 18 of Part Four of the Civil Law. (In the wording of the law of 29.11.2012, which enters into force on 01.01.2013. See the law of 29.11.2012.)

65. The founder of a permanent arbitral tribunal registered in the Arbitral Tribunal Register shall submit to the Enterprise Register by 1 April 2013 a certificate that the arbitrator complies with the requirements of the second part of Article 497 of this law, attaching documents substantiating the arbitrator's qualifications. (In the wording of the law of 29.11.2012, which enters into force on 01.01.2013.)

66. If the parties have agreed to submit a dispute to a permanent arbitral tribunal and the founder of this arbitral tribunal has not submitted, in the manner prescribed by regulatory enactments, by 1 April 2013 a certificate regarding the compliance of the arbitrator in the permanent arbitral tribunal with the requirements of the second part of Article 497 of this law, the parties shall agree on the submission of the dispute for resolution to another arbitral tribunal. If no agreement is reached, the dispute shall be examined in court. (In the wording of the law of 29.11.2012, which enters into force on 01.01.2013.)

67. An arbitrator who does not comply with the requirements of the second part of Article 497 of this law shall complete the arbitral proceedings initiated before the entry into force of these amendments in the respective arbitral tribunal. (In the wording of the law of 29.11.2012, which enters into force on 01.01.2013.)

68. The provisions of Chapter 30.4 of this law shall not be applicable to the examination of claim applications received by the court until 30 June 2013. (In the wording of the law of 18.04.2013, which enters into force on 22.05.2013.)

69. The amendment to Article 400 of this law regarding its supplementation with part 1.1, which provides that the first part of the article shall not be applicable to notarial acts drawn up in the procedure prescribed in Section D1 of the Notariate Law, shall apply to those notarial acts that were drawn up after 31 October 2013. (In the wording of the law of 23.05.2013, which enters into force on 01.11.2013.)

70. Cases concerning the undisputed compulsory enforcement of obligations, based on obligations according to which undisputed compulsory enforcement was permissible until 31 October 2013, shall be examined in the procedure prescribed in this law that was in force until 31 October 2013. (In the wording of the law of 23.05.2013, which enters into force on 01.11.2013.)

71. Paragraph 5 of the second part of Article 539 and paragraph 15 of Article 540 of this law shall apply to those notarial acts that were drawn up after 31 October 2013. (In the wording of the law of 23.05.2013, which enters into force on 01.11.2013.)

72. The amendments to the first part of Article 551 and the first and second parts of Article 594 of this law, which provide that the debtor shall retain wages and payments equivalent thereto in an amount not less than the minimum monthly wage and for each dependent minor child funds in the amount of the state social security benefit, shall enter into force on 1 January 2014. In enforcement cases that have been entered into the records of a sworn bailiff and have not been completed by the time of entry into force of the amendments to the first and second parts of Article 594 of this law and in which the enforcement measure of levying execution on the wages or payments equivalent thereto payable to the debtor is applied, the amount of funds to be retained for the debtor as prescribed in the first and second parts of Article 594 of this law for the period from the entry into force of the amendments referred to in the first and second parts of Article 594 of this law until the time when the amount of debt to be recovered specified in the sworn bailiff's order has been extinguished or the applied enforcement measure has been revoked shall be calculated by the employer or the respective legal person at the time when the deduction is made from the debtor's wages or payments equivalent thereto. (In the wording of the law of 23.05.2013, with amendments made by the law of 19.12.2013, which enters into force on 04.01.2014.)

73. (Deleted by the law of 10.12.2020, which enters into force on 31.12.2020.)

74. The amendments to Article 250.27 of this law regarding the appeal of court judgments rendered in cases concerning small claims in the appellate procedure shall enter into force on 1 April 2014. (In the wording of the law of 19.12.2013, which enters into force on 04.01.2014.)

75. The amendments to Article 250.27 of this law regarding the appeal of court judgments rendered in cases concerning small claims in the appellate procedure shall apply to judgments that were pronounced or — if judgments were rendered in written proceedings — drawn up after 1 April 2014. (In the wording of the law of 19.12.2013, which enters into force on 04.01.2014.)

76. The provisions of paragraph 10 of the second part of Article 406.3 of this law regarding the inclusion of a certificate in the application shall not be applicable to the examination of applications submitted to the court until 1 July 2014. (In the wording of the law of 19.12.2013, which enters into force on 04.01.2014.)

77. The founder of a permanent arbitral tribunal registered in the Arbitral Tribunal Register shall submit to the Enterprise Register by 15 July 2014 amendments to the regulations in accordance with the amendments to Article 486.1 of this law. (In the wording of the law of 22.05.2014, which enters into force on 05.06.2014.)

78. If the founder of a permanent arbitral tribunal registered in the Arbitral Tribunal Register has not submitted the said documents to the Enterprise Register within the time limit specified in paragraph 77 of these transitional provisions, the Enterprise Register shall, by 15 September 2014, in accordance with the Cabinet of Ministers Regulations of 29 March 2005 No. 204 "Regulations on the Arbitral Tribunal Register", decide on the deletion of the permanent arbitral tribunal from the Arbitral Tribunal Register. (In the wording of the law of 22.05.2014, which enters into force on 05.06.2014.)

79. If the parties have agreed to submit a civil dispute for resolution to a permanent arbitral tribunal that has been deleted from the permanent arbitral tribunal register in accordance with paragraph 78 of these transitional provisions, the parties shall agree on the submission of the civil dispute for resolution to another arbitral tribunal. If no agreement is reached, the dispute shall be examined in the district (city) court. (In the wording of the law of 22.05.2014, which enters into force on 05.06.2014.)

80. A permanent arbitral tribunal that has been deleted from the permanent arbitral tribunal register in accordance with paragraph 78 of these transitional provisions may complete the examination of commenced cases, but not later than until 31 December 2014. (In the wording of the law of 22.05.2014, which enters into force on 05.06.2014.)

81. The founder of a permanent arbitral tribunal deleted from the Arbitral Tribunal Register shall, by 1 October 2014, transfer the procedural documents for storage to the National Archives of Latvia, covering the costs of storing the procedural documents. (In the wording of the law of 22.05.2014, which enters into force on 05.06.2014.)

82. An application for the compulsory enforcement of a permanent arbitral tribunal award or for refusal to issue a writ of execution for the compulsory enforcement of a permanent arbitral tribunal award, which was received until 31 December 2014, shall be examined by the court in the procedure that was in force at the time of rendering the permanent arbitral tribunal award. (In the wording of the law of 11.09.2014, which enters into force on 01.11.2014.)

83. The amendments to Part D of this law regarding the procedure for enforcement of a permanent arbitral tribunal award and regarding the deletion of Chapters 61, 62, 63, 64 and 65 shall enter into force on 1 January 2015. (In the wording of the law of 11.09.2014, which enters into force on 01.11.2014.)

84. The third part of Article 611 of this law regarding the electronic submission of an application for the registration of immovable property in the name of the acquirer, the third part of Article 613 of this law regarding access to the Enforcement Cases Register and the fifth part of Article 615 of this law regarding the electronic submission of an application for the registration of immovable property in the name of the successful bidder, co-owner or creditor and for the deletion of debts registered in the land register shall begin to be applied with the availability of the respective technical support, but not later than 1 January 2015. (In the wording of the law of 11.09.2014, which enters into force on 01.11.2014.)

85. Cases concerning the registration of immovable property in the name of the acquirer (person who has taken over the immovable property or successful bidder), which were accepted for examination by the regional court until 31 October 2014, shall be examined in the procedure prescribed in the Civil Procedure Law that was in force until 31 October 2014. (In the wording of the law of 11.09.2014, which enters into force on 01.11.2014.)

86. The Civil Cases Chamber of the Supreme Court shall examine ancillary complaints regarding decisions adopted by the regional court when examining cases concerning the registration of immovable property in the name of the acquirer (person who has taken over the immovable property or successful bidder), if they were accepted for examination by the regional court until 31 October 2014. A decision of the Civil Chamber of the Supreme Court, which, when examining an ancillary complaint, was adopted after 1 November 2014 and by which the decision of the regional court was revoked and the matter was referred for new examination, shall be referred for new examination to the land register department of the district (city) court according to the location of the immovable property. (In the wording of the law of 11.09.2014, which enters into force on 01.11.2014.)

87. Cases that were examined in the regional court as a court of first instance and in which the date for pronouncement of the judgment was set after 31 December 2014, as well as ancillary complaints regarding decisions of the regional court as a court of first instance that were pronounced after 31 December 2014, shall be examined in the appellate procedure by the same regional court as a court of appellate instance, but in a new composition of the court. (In the wording of the law of 30.10.2014, which enters into force on 01.01.2015.)

88. Cases in respect of which appellate proceedings have been initiated in the Civil Cases Chamber of the Supreme Court and ancillary complaints regarding decisions pronounced by the regional court as a court of first instance, but which have not been examined by 31 December 2016, including cases in which a decision has been adopted to suspend proceedings, shall be referred for examination to the regional court as a court of appellate instance, but in a new composition of the court. (In the wording of the law of 30.10.2014, with amendments made by the law of 28.05.2015, which enters into force on 02.07.2015.)

89. Cases that were initiated for examination in the regional court as a court of first instance until 31 December 2014, but the examination of which on the merits has not been commenced by 30 June 2015, shall be referred for examination to the district (city) court as a court of first instance. (In the wording of the law of 30.10.2014, which enters into force on 01.01.2015.)

90. Cases that the regional court as a court of first instance has commenced to examine on the merits shall be examined in the same court in which they were submitted. Cases that the regional court as a court of first instance has commenced to examine on the merits, but which have not been examined by 31 December 2015 due to the fact that a decision has been adopted to suspend proceedings in them, shall be referred for examination to the district (city) court as a court of first instance. (In the wording of the law of 10.12.2015, which enters into force on 01.01.2016.)

91. After 1 January 2015, the court of cassation instance, revoking a decision of the Civil Cases Chamber of the Supreme Court as a court of appellate instance, shall refer the case for new examination to the regional court as a court of appellate instance or to the city (district) court as a court of first instance (paragraph 2 of Article 474). The court of appellate instance, revoking a judgment of the regional court as a court of first instance (Article 427), a decision on termination of proceedings, a decision on leaving a claim without examination, as well as a decision on refusal to accept a claim application (Article 132) and a decision on leaving a claim application without progress (Article 133), shall refer the case for new examination to the district (city) court as a court of first instance. In such a case, the case shall be referred to the court in accordance with the provisions on jurisdiction of civil disputes. (In the wording of the law of 30.10.2014, with amendments made by the law of 10.12.2015, which enters into force on 01.01.2016.)

92. If after 1 January 2015, in a case that was examined in the regional court as a court of first instance, matters related to the enforcement of the decision are to be resolved, they shall be resolved by the regional court that adopted the decision. (In the wording of the law of 30.10.2014, which enters into force on 01.01.2015.)

93. If after 1 January 2016, in a case that was examined in the Civil Cases Chamber of the Supreme Court in the appellate procedure, matters related to the enforcement of the decision are to be resolved, they shall be sent for resolution to the regional court as a court of appellate instance. (In the wording of the law of 30.10.2014, which enters into force on 01.01.2015.)

94. A court that has commenced to examine a civil case before 1 January 2015, the materials of which include a state secret object, shall complete its examination. (In the wording of the law of 30.10.2014, which enters into force on 01.01.2015.)

95. Cases examined in the Civil Cases Chamber of the Supreme Court regarding decisions and actions of a land register department judge, in which after 1 January 2015 the court of cassation instance has revoked the decision of the Civil Cases Chamber of the Supreme Court, shall be referred for new examination to the regional court in whose territory of operation the land register department of the district (city) court is located. The Civil Cases Chamber of the Supreme Court shall refer complaints regarding decisions and actions of a land register department judge that have not been examined by 31 December 2016, including complaints in which a decision has been adopted to suspend proceedings, for examination to the regional court in whose territory of operation the land register department of the district (city) court is located. (In the wording of the law of 30.10.2014, which enters into force on 01.01.2015.)

96. Ancillary complaints submitted regarding decisions adopted by the regional court as a court of first instance, the time limit for appeal of which expires until 31 December 2014, shall be examined in the appellate procedure in the procedure that was in force until 31 December 2014. (In the wording of the law of 30.10.2014, which enters into force on 01.01.2015.)

97. The amendments to Articles 540, 541.1, 555, 559, 644, 644.2 and 644.3 of this law with regard to Council Regulation No. 44/2001 and Regulation (EU) No. 1215/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council shall enter into force on 10 January 2015. (In the wording of the law of 30.10.2014, which enters into force on 01.01.2015.)

98. The amendments to Articles 541.1, 543.1, 545.1 and 644.3 of this law with regard to Regulation (EU) No. 606/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council shall enter into force on 11 January 2015. (In the wording of the law of 30.10.2014, which enters into force on 01.01.2015.)

99. Proceedings that were commenced, public documents that were officially drawn up and registered, and court settlements that were approved or concluded in the period from 1 May 2004 to 9 January 2015 shall be subject to the third part of Article 541.1 and the second part of Article 644 of this law in the wording that was in force until 9 January 2015. (In the wording of the law of 30.10.2014, which enters into force on 01.01.2015.)

100. Applications to be examined in the procedure prescribed in Chapters 77.1 and 77.2 of this law, which were submitted to the district (city) court until 28 February 2015, but the examination of the case on the merits has not been commenced, shall be referred for examination to the Riga City Ziemeļu District Court. Applications to be examined in the procedure prescribed in Chapters 77.1 and 77.2 of this law, which were submitted to the district (city) court until 28 February 2015 and the examination of the case on the merits has been commenced, shall be completed by the court in which the application was submitted. (In the wording of the law of 30.10.2014, which enters into force on 01.03.2015.)

101. If after 1 March 2015, in a case concerning the unlawful removal of a child across the border to a foreign country or retention in a foreign country, if the child's place of residence is in Latvia, and unlawful removal across the border to Latvia or retention in Latvia, if the child's place of residence is in another country, matters related to the enforcement of the decision are to be resolved, they shall be examined by the Riga City Ziemeļu District Court. (In the wording of the law of 30.10.2014, which enters into force on 01.03.2015.)

102. The court shall adopt a decision on termination of the insolvency proceedings of a legal person if an application has been received from the Insolvency Control Service for the removal of the administrator and termination of the insolvency proceedings of the legal person in the case specified in paragraph 27 of the transitional provisions of the Insolvency Law. (In the wording of the law of 12.02.2015, with amendments made by the law of 31.05.2018, which enters into force on 01.07.2018.)

103. The court that adopts the decision referred to in paragraph 102 of the transitional provisions of this law shall, at the request of the Insolvency Control Service, instruct the administrator removed from the insolvency proceedings to perform the actions related to the deletion of the debtor from the Enterprise Register. If the administrator does not submit to the court an application for termination of the insolvency proceedings due to the fact that the sale of property has not been commenced or has not been completed or the satisfaction of creditors' claims has not been commenced or has not been completed, at the request of the Insolvency Control Service, the court shall, in addition to the obligation referred to in this paragraph, instruct the administrator removed from the insolvency proceedings to perform the actions related to the completion of the insolvency proceedings. (In the wording of the law of 12.02.2015, with amendments made by the law of 31.05.2018, which enters into force on 01.07.2018.)

104. In legal protection proceedings, legal person insolvency proceedings and natural person insolvency proceedings commenced until 30 June 2012, the court shall examine complaints in the procedure prescribed in Chapters 45.1, 46.1 and 46.2 of this law. (In the wording of the law of 12.02.2015, which enters into force on 01.03.2015.)

105. If an application for natural person insolvency proceedings was submitted until 1 March 2015, then the wording of Articles 363.25 and 363.27 of this law that was in force on the date of submission of the application for natural person insolvency proceedings shall apply. (In the wording of the law of 12.02.2015, which enters into force on 01.03.2015.)

106. The amendments to Chapter 73 of this law, which are related to the organisation of an auction of immovable property on an electronic auction website, shall enter into force on 1 July 2015. Insolvency proceedings administrators, when organising an auction of immovable property, shall apply the said amendments from 1 January 2016. Auctions that the bailiff has announced until 30 June 2015 shall take place in accordance with the procedure that was in force until 30 June 2015. Auctions that the insolvency proceedings administrator has announced until 31 December 2015 shall take place in accordance with the procedure that was in force until 31 December 2015. (In the wording of the law of 28.05.2015, which enters into force on 02.07.2015.)

107. The amendments to paragraph 2 of the first part of Article 594 of this law, which provide for retaining for the debtor wages and payments equivalent thereto in the amount of 50 percent of the minimum monthly wage, shall enter into force on 1 July 2015. In the enforcement cases referred to in paragraph 2 of the first part of Article 594 of this law, which have been entered into the bailiff's records and have not been completed by 30 June 2015 and in which the enforcement measure of levying execution on the wages or payments equivalent thereto payable to the debtor is applied, from 1 July 2015 until the time when the amount of debt to be recovered specified in the bailiff's order has been extinguished or the applied enforcement measure has been revoked, the amount of funds to be retained for the debtor shall be independently calculated by the employer or the respective legal person (addressee of the bailiff's order) at the time when the deduction is made from the debtor's wages or payments equivalent thereto in accordance with the amendments to the first part of Article 594 of this law that entered into force from 1 July 2015. (In the wording of the law of 28.05.2015, which enters into force on 02.07.2015.)

108. The amendments to the third part of Article 250.2, paragraph 3 of Article 401 and the second part of Article 644 of this law with regard to the European Certificate of Succession and Regulation (EU) No. 650/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council shall enter into force on 17 August 2015. (In the wording of the law of 28.05.2015, which enters into force on 02.07.2015.)

109. At the proposal of the President of the Civil Cases Chamber of the Supreme Court, the President of the Supreme Court shall decide on the referral of a case pending in the Civil Cases Chamber of the Supreme Court to another court of appellate instance if it is not possible to ensure the examination of the case by 31 December 2016. The decision shall be adopted in the form of a resolution and shall not be subject to appeal. The case shall be referred to another court of appellate instance, observing the conditions of the fifth and sixth parts of Article 32.1 of this law. (In the wording of the law of 28.05.2015, which enters into force on 02.07.2015.)

110. The Civil Cases Chamber of the Supreme Court, revoking the judgment of the regional court as a court of first instance in the cases specified in Article 427 of this law, shall send the case for new examination to the court of first instance in accordance with the provisions on jurisdiction of civil disputes. (In the wording of the law of 28.05.2015, which enters into force on 02.07.2015.)

111. In enforcement cases concerning the enforcement of decisions arising from guardianship or contact rights, which were entered before the date of entry into force of Chapters 74.4 and 74.5 of this law, the bailiff shall, after the entry into force of the said chapters, send the notification specified in Article 620.17 or Article 620.23 of this law and shall carry out the enforcement of subsequent decisions in the procedure prescribed in the respective chapter. If in an enforcement case concerning the enforcement of a decision arising from guardianship or contact rights the court has imposed a fine in accordance with Article 620 of this law, it shall be credited towards the fine imposed in accordance with Article 620.18 or Article 620.25 of this law. (In the wording of the law of 29.10.2015, which enters into force on 03.12.2015.)

112. Paragraph 4 of the third part of Article 33 and Article 44.1 of this law shall apply to cases initiated after 1 March 2016. (In the wording of the law of 10.12.2015, which enters into force on 01.01.2016.)

The amendments regarding the deletion of the third part of Article 539, paragraph 9 of Article 540 and the fifth part of Article 567 of this law shall enter into force simultaneously with the Law on International and National Sanctions of the Republic of Latvia. Enforcement proceedings in cases concerning the compulsory enforcement of a decision of the responsible institution regarding sanctions imposed by international organisations, which have been entered into the bailiff's records until the date of entry into force of the Law on International and National Sanctions of the Republic of Latvia, shall be terminated by the bailiff, revoking all enforcement measures adopted in connection with the enforcement of such a decision. The costs of enforcement of the judgment incurred in the enforcement case shall be reimbursed to the bailiff in accordance with the requirements of the regulatory enactments that were in force until the date of entry into force of the Law on International and National Sanctions of the Republic of Latvia. (In the wording of the law of 04.02.2016, which enters into force on 29.02.2016.)

114. The amendments made in connection with interpreters in the fourth part of Article 13, the third part of Article 33, supplementing it with paragraph 5, paragraph 4 of the first part of Article 44 and supplementing the article with paragraph 5, as well as supplementing the article with the sixth part, the third part of Article 54, Article 55, supplementing it with paragraph 8, the seventh part of Article 74, supplementing it with paragraph 2.1, paragraph 3 of the first part of Article 210 and supplementing the part with paragraph 6 of this law shall enter into force on 31 July 2016. (In the wording of the law of 04.02.2016, which enters into force on 29.02.2016.)

115. Paragraph 18 of Article 540, part 2.2 of Article 560, paragraph 15 of the first part of Article 562 and paragraph 12 of the first part of Article 563 of this law shall enter into force on 18 June 2016. (In the wording of the law of 04.02.2016, which enters into force on 29.02.2016.)

116. A court that has commenced to examine applications for new examination of a case due to newly discovered circumstances until 1 August 2016 shall complete their examination. The examination of those applications that have been referred for examination to the Civil Cases Chamber of the Supreme Court shall be decided in accordance with paragraph 109 of these transitional provisions. (In the wording of the law of 09.06.2016, which enters into force on 13.07.2016.)

117. Bailiff's orders issued until 30 June 2017 regarding the attachment and transfer of funds deposited with a credit institution or other payment service provider to the bailiff's deposit account shall be enforced by applying the provisions of this law that were in force until 30 June 2017. (In the wording of the law of 23.11.2016, which enters into force on 01.01.2017.)

118. From 1 July 2019, the orders referred to in Article 599.1 of this law shall be issued, enforced and information on their enforcement shall be provided using the State Information System Connector under the administration of the State Regional Development Agency. (In the wording of the law of 23.11.2016, which enters into force on 01.01.2017.)

119. Until 30 June 2019, the orders referred to in Article 599.1 of this law shall be received and enforced using the State Information System Connector under the administration of the State Regional Development Agency by those credit institutions and other payment service providers that have informed the Court Administration of the commencement of electronic data exchange. Until notification of electronic data exchange, bailiff's orders regarding the attachment and transfer of funds deposited with a credit institution to the bailiff's deposit account shall be enforced by applying the provisions of this law that were in force until 30 June 2017. (In the wording of the law of 23.11.2016, which enters into force on 01.01.2017.)

120. The amendments to the fifth part of Article 142, the seventh part of Article 555, Article 557, the first and second parts of Article 572, the deletion of the third part of Article 599, as well as the supplementation of the law with Article 599.1 of this law shall enter into force on 1 July 2017. (In the wording of the law of 23.11.2016, which enters into force on 01.01.2017.)

121. The amendments to Articles 34, 207, 540, 549, 563, 568, 643 and 644 of this law in connection with the European Account Preservation Order and Chapter 77.3 shall enter into force on 18 January 2017. (In the wording of the law of 08.12.2016, which enters into force on 04.01.2017.)

122. The amendments to Article 250.19 of this law regarding the initiation of a case for the recovery of maintenance in the minimum amount prescribed by the Cabinet of Ministers, the amendments to paragraph 5 of Article 596 regarding non-levying of execution on child maintenance in the minimum amount prescribed by the Cabinet of Ministers, which, based on a decision of the Maintenance Guarantee Fund Administration, is paid by one of the parents, as well as the amendments to paragraph 1 of the first part of Article 623 regarding first-priority recovery claims shall enter into force on 1 April 2017. (In the wording of the law of 08.12.2016, which enters into force on 04.01.2017.)

123. The amendments to the first and third parts of Article 572.1 of this law regarding recovery in favour of the Maintenance Guarantee Fund Administration shall enter into force on 1 February 2017 and shall apply to enforcement cases entered as of 1 February 2017. (In the wording of the law of 08.12.2016, which enters into force on 04.01.2017.)

124. Claims for the recovery of maintenance for the support of a child in the minimum amount prescribed by the Cabinet of Ministers, which were brought in court until 1 April 2017, shall be examined in the procedure prescribed in the Civil Procedure Law that was in force until 1 April 2017. (In the wording of the law of 08.12.2016, which enters into force on 04.01.2017.)

125. The amendments regarding the deletion of Articles 341.9 and 363.6 of this law, as well as the amendments to paragraph 10 of the first part of Article 43, Articles 341.5, 341.6, 341.7, 341.8, 341.10, 363.1, 363.2, 363.9, 363.10 and 363.11 of this law, which respectively introduce the regulation of the supervisory person and prescribe the resolution of matters related thereto in legal protection proceedings and out-of-court legal protection proceedings, restrict the rights and obligations of the administrator in legal protection proceedings and out-of-court legal protection proceedings, as well as prescribe the regulation of the application for insolvency proceedings by creditors and the majority of creditors specified in the third part of Article 42 of the Insolvency Law in legal person insolvency proceedings, shall enter into force on 1 July 2017 and shall be applicable with respect to legal protection proceedings and out-of-court legal protection proceedings that were commenced starting from 1 July 2017 and legal person insolvency proceedings following these proceedings. The provisions of this law that were in force on the date of commencement of the respective legal protection proceedings or out-of-court legal protection proceedings shall apply to legal protection proceedings and out-of-court legal protection proceedings that were commenced until 30 June 2017 and insolvency proceedings following them. (In the wording of the law of 01.06.2017, which enters into force on 01.07.2017.)

126. The amendments to Articles 485.1 and 541.1 of this law in connection with Regulation (EC) No. 861/2007 of the European Parliament and of the Council shall enter into force on 14 July 2017. (In the wording of the law of 01.06.2017, which enters into force on 01.07.2017.)

127. The amendments to the third part of Article 611 and the fifth part of Article 615 of this law regarding the electronic submission of an application to the land register department of the district (city) court using the Court Information System, and the amendments to the second part of Article 617 of this law regarding the submission of a complaint to any land register department shall enter into force on 1 September 2017. (In the wording of the law of 01.06.2017, which enters into force on 01.07.2017.)

Part 1.1 of Article 567 of this law regarding the exemption of the creditor from the obligation to specify the enforcement measure, paragraph 2.1 of the second part regarding the exemption of the victim from the costs of enforcement of the judgment, part 4.1 regarding the coverage of the costs of enforcement of the judgment shall enter into force on 1 January 2019. (In the wording of the law of 22.06.2017, which enters into force on 01.08.2017.)

The amendments to the sixth part of Article 582 of this law regarding the obligation to make a note in the State Register of Vehicles and their Drivers regarding the date of alienation of an attached vehicle and the acquirer shall enter into force on 1 January 2018. (In the wording of the law of 22.06.2017, which enters into force on 01.08.2017.)

Applications for compensation for damages for infringements of competition law submitted to the district (city) court until the date on which the procedure prescribed in Chapter 30.6 of this law regarding infringements of competition law entered into force, if the examination of the case on the merits has not been commenced, shall be referred for examination to the Riga City Latgale Suburb Court. Applications for compensation for damages for infringements of competition law submitted to the district (city) court until the date on which the procedure prescribed in Chapter 30.6 of this law regarding infringements of competition law entered into force, if the examination of the case on the merits has been commenced, shall be completed by the court to which the application was submitted. (In the wording of the law of 19.10.2017, which enters into force on 01.11.2017.)

The amendments to Article 82 of this law regarding the deletion of the sixth and seventh parts, the supplementation of the law with Article 82.1 and the amendments to Article 83 regarding restrictions on representation in court shall enter into force on 1 January 2019. (In the wording of the law of 14.12.2017, which enters into force on 15.01.2018.)

Cases of natural persons or legal persons referred to in paragraphs 1 and 2 of the first part of Article 82.1 of this law, which until 31 December 2018 are conducted in the court of first instance or appellate instance through a representative, may be completed by conducting them in the court of first instance or appellate instance through this representative. (In the wording of the law of 14.12.2017, which enters into force on 15.01.2018.)

134. Until the date of entry into force of the Cabinet of Ministers regulations referred to in the first part of Article 250.20 and the first part of Article 250.23 of this law, but not later than until 1 July 2018, the Cabinet of Ministers Regulations of 11 October 2011 No. 783 "Regulations on Forms to be Used in Small Claims" shall be applicable, taking into account the amendments made to these articles, by which the term "cases concerning small claims" is replaced with the term "simplified procedure cases". (In the wording of the law of 14.12.2017, which enters into force on 15.01.2018.)

Applications for the submission of a request to a foreign country for the return of a child to Latvia (Chapter 77.1), which were submitted to the Latvian court until 14 January 2018, shall be examined in the procedure prescribed in this law that was in force until 15 January 2018. (In the wording of the law of 14.12.2017, which enters into force on 15.01.2018.)

136. An ancillary complaint regarding a decision of the district (city) court, which, when examining a complaint regarding the actions of the bailiff of Riga Regional Court district No. 35, Riga Regional Court district No. 36 or Riga Regional Court district No. 37 in the enforcement of a judgment (Article 632), was pronounced until 28 February 2018, shall be examined by the Riga Regional Court. (In the wording of the law of 14.12.2017, which enters into force on 15.01.2018.)

137. The amendments to the third part of Article 14, Article 62in the first part, 187th, 193rd, 194th, 199th, 208th, 230.1, 231st,
250.25, 250.26, 250.27, 250.36, 250.42 articles, in the second part of Article 415, Article 442, in the third part of Article 452, in the second part of Article 454, Articles 464.3, 472 and 477.1 in connection with the procedure, form and content of making a summary judgment, requests for drafting a judgment, the procedure, form and content of making a summary decision, as well as the procedure for pronouncing a judgment, summary judgment, decision and summary decision shall enter into force on 1 March 2018. (In the wording of the law of 14.12.2017, which enters into force on 15.01.2018.)

138. Cases initiated for small claims and cases in which the dispute was examined by the Industrial Property Appeals Board until the date of entry into force of the amendments to Articles 250.25, 250.26 and 250.27 of this law regarding summary judgment and request for drafting a judgment shall be examined in accordance with the procedure set out in Articles 250.25, 250.26 and 250.27 of this law as it was in force until 1 March 2018. (In the wording of the law of 14.12.2017, which enters into force on 15.01.2018.)

the fourth part of Article 449, the seventh part of Article 464, Articles 443.1 and 444.1 in connection with the content of an ancillary complaint, replacement of the state fee for an ancillary complaint with a security deposit and the amount of this security deposit, the procedure for payment and refund shall enter into force on 1 March 2018. (In the wording of the law of 14.12.2017, which enters into force on 15.01.2018.)

34 of this law regarding the deletion of the fifth part, amendments to the first part of Article 41, Article 445, the fourth part of Article 449,
the seventh part of Article 464 regarding the handling of the security deposit and until the date of entry into force of the supplementation of the law with Article 444.1 regarding payment of the security deposit in ancillary complaints shall be examined in accordance with the procedure set out in this law as it was in force until 1 March 2018. (In the wording of the law of 14.12.2017, which enters into force on 15.01.2018.)

141. After the amendments to Articles 187, 194, 199, 230.1 and 231 of this law regarding the procedure, form and content of making a summary judgment, as well as the procedure, form and content of making summary decisions have entered into force, in cases where a summary ruling has been made in accordance with the procedure set out in this law as it was in force until
1 March 2018, the full ruling shall also be drafted in accordance with the procedure set out in this law as it was in force until 1 March 2018. (In the wording of the law of 14.12.2017, which enters into force on 15.01.2018.)

142. An auction of movable property announced until 30 June 2018 shall be held in accordance with the provisions that were in force on the date of announcement of the auction. (In the wording of the law of 01.03.2018, which enters into force on 01.07.2018.)

The State Revenue Service and the State Social Insurance Agency, until the development of appropriate legal regulation, but no later than until 31 December 2018, in cases specified in the regulatory enactments regulating their activities, shall apply the provisions of Chapter 71 "Enforcement against Movable Property" of this law that were in force until
30 June 2018. (In the wording of the law of 01.03.2018, which enters into force on 01.07.2018.)

144. Chapter 30.7 of this law, which sets out the procedure for examining disputes in cases concerning rights in insolvency proceedings and applications for the determination of interim protection measures, shall apply to insolvency proceedings of legal persons that are commenced after 30 June 2018. (In the wording of the law of 31.05.2018, which enters into force on 01.07.2018. The numbering of the article has been amended by the law of 25.10.2018, which enters into force on 28.11.2018.)

145. To decisions of first instance courts on the removal of an administrator from the relevant legal protection proceedings, insolvency proceedings of a legal person or insolvency proceedings of a natural person, which were adopted until 30 June 2018, the third and seventh parts of Article 341.8, the third and twelfth parts of Article 363.14, the third and ninth parts of Article 363.28 of this law shall apply in the wording that was in force until 30 June 2018. (In the wording of the law of 31.05.2018, which enters into force on 01.07.2018. The numbering of the article has been amended by the law of 25.10.2018, which enters into force on 28.11.2018.)

Point 3 of the second part of Article 341.2 and the second sentence of the fourth part of Article 363.11 of this law shall apply to legal protection proceedings cases that are commenced after 30 June 2018. (In the wording of the law of 31.05.2018, which enters into force on 01.07.2018. The numbering of the article has been amended by the law of 25.10.2018, which enters into force on 28.11.2018.)

147. Amendments to the first part of Article 56.2 of this law by supplementing it with point 5, to the first part of Article 656, Articles 664, 666, the first part of Article 667, the third part of Article 670, as well as amendments regarding the deletion of Articles 658, 661, 665, the fourth part of Article 673 and Article 674 and the supplementation of this law with Chapter 81.1 in connection with the transfer of the function of service of foreign court or extrajudicial documents to bailiffs and the service of documents in accordance with the Hague Convention of 1965 shall enter into force on 1 January 2019. (In the wording of the law of 31.05.2018, which enters into force on 01.07.2018. The numbering of the article has been amended by the law of 25.10.2018, which enters into force on 28.11.2018.)

148. Amendments to the fourth part of Article 620 of this law regarding the increase of the amount of the fine and to the fifth part regarding the submission of an application for the initiation of criminal proceedings if the debtor continues to fail to comply with the judgment after the imposition of a fine shall enter into force on 1 July 2019. (In the wording of the law of 31.05.2018, which enters into force on 01.07.2018. The numbering of the article has been amended by the law of 25.10.2018, which enters into force on 28.11.2018.)

149. Until the date when amendments to the Civil Procedure Law enter into force providing that applications for undisputed enforcement shall be submitted only electronically, Riga City Vidzeme Suburb Court shall examine applications for undisputed enforcement:

1) in monetary payment obligations, obligations to return movable property or obligations under contracts secured by a commercial pledge, if the debtor's declared place of residence, or, if there is none, — place of residence or legal address is in the administrative territory of Riga City; 2) under real estate mortgage deeds and under obligations to vacate or return leased or rented real estate, if the real estate is located in the administrative territory of Riga City. (In the wording of the law of 25.10.2018, which enters into force on 28.11.2018.)

150. Until the date when amendments to the Civil Procedure Law enter into force providing that applications for compulsory enforcement of an obligation in warning procedure shall be submitted only electronically, Riga City Vidzeme Suburb Court shall examine applications if the debtor's declared place of residence, or, if there is none, — place of residence or legal address is in the administrative territory of Riga City. (In the wording of the law of 25.10.2018, which enters into force on 28.11.2018.)

151. Amendments regarding the replacement of the words "land register department" (in the respective case) and the words "land register department of the district (city) court" (in the respective case) throughout the law, the deletion of the third sentence of the first part of Article 24,
the expression of the fourth part of Article 363.15 in a new wording, the supplementation of the first part of Article 403, the deletion of the words "and of the judge of the land register department of the district (city) court" in point 1 of the first part of Article 443, the replacement of the words "decision of the judge of the land register department" in the third part of Article 449 shall enter into force on 1 June 2019. (In the wording of the law of 25.10.2018, which enters into force on 28.11.2018.)

153. Until 31 December 2020, applications submitted to court, the examination of which falls within the jurisdiction of the Economic Court, shall be examined by the court in which the applications were submitted. 154. The court of appeal, by setting aside the judgment of a district (city) court in a case that falls within the jurisdiction of the Economic Court, shall refer the case for new examination to the Economic Court. (In the wording of the law of 01.10.2020, which enters into force on 01.01.2021.)

155. The court of cassation, by setting aside a judgment in a case that falls within the jurisdiction of the Economic Court, shall refer the case for new examination to the Economic Court or Riga Regional Court. (In the wording of the law of 01.10.2020, which enters into force on 01.01.2021.)

156. Until 31 December 2020, applications submitted to court regarding copyright and related rights and database makers' rights (sui generis) shall be examined by the court in which the applications were submitted. In these cases, rulings appealed in the appeal procedure shall be examined by Riga Regional Court. (In the wording of the law of 01.10.2020, which enters into force on 01.01.2021.)

The court of appeal, by setting aside the judgment of a district (city) court in a case regarding copyright and related rights and database makers' rights (sui generis), shall refer the case for new examination to Riga City Vidzeme Suburb Court. (In the wording of the law of 01.10.2020, which enters into force on 01.01.2021.)

The court of cassation, by setting aside a judgment in a case regarding copyright and related rights and database makers' rights (sui generis), shall refer the case for new examination to Riga City Vidzeme Suburb Court or Riga Regional Court. (In the wording of the law of 01.10.2020, which enters into force on 01.01.2021.)

159. The payments to be retained for the debtor in the amount of the state social security benefit for each dependent minor child specified in the first, second and fifth parts of Article 594 of this law until 31 December 2021 shall be determined in the amount of 64.03 euros, which corresponds to the amount of the state social security benefit on 31 December 2020. (In the wording of the law of 10.12.2020, which enters into force on 31.12.2020.)

160. The amendment to the second part of Article 250.19 of this law in connection with the detachment of a claim for the recovery of maintenance for a child from the minimum amount determined by the Cabinet of Ministers and part 2.1 of Article 250.19 of this law shall enter into force on 1 January 2021. (In the wording of the law of 10.12.2020, which enters into force on 31.12.2020.)

161. Amendments to Article 628 of this law, which include in the sequence of claims to be satisfied claims for payments for management activities in a multi-apartment residential building (management expenses), for payments for services necessary for the maintenance of the house (utility services) and payments to the accumulation fund of the apartment owners' community (accumulations), shall apply to rulings on debt obligations that arose after 31 December 2022. (In the wording of the law of 21.01.2021, which enters into force on 01.03.2021.)

162. The second part of Article 195 and point 2 of Article 625 of this law shall apply to claims filed after
28 February 2021. (In the wording of the law of 21.01.2021, which enters into force on 01.03.2021.)

31 December 2022 and the period from 1 January 2023. (In the wording of the law of 21.01.2021, which enters into force on 01.03.2021.)

164. Point 7.1 of the first part of Article 250.47, Article 250.54A, part 4.1 of Article 250.59 and the amendment to the fifth part of this article, the amendment to the first part of Article 250.60, the sixth part of Article 250.62, as well as Article 250.62A of this law in connection with the interim protection measure against violence — the obligation of the respondent to complete a social rehabilitation course for the reduction of violent behaviour — shall enter into force on 1 July 2021. (In the wording of the law of 25.03.2021 with amendments made by the law of 11.11.2021, which enters into force on 01.12.2021.)
